severity_policy.rule: Any Critical finding makes the sample ineligible regardless of numeric total.

category_rationale.source_and_formula: The artifact preserves anchored Q/K/V projections, QK^T/√m attention scaling, softmax weights, AV value aggregation, multi-head composition, and the exact permutation-equivariance equation. Its limitations explicitly exclude flagged hidden-text chunks and restrict claims to clean, visible slide content.
category_rationale.core_coverage: Complete coverage of CNN locality limits, patch tokens, token mixing, token-wise MLPs, dynamic attention, Q/K/V, multi-head attention, ViT blocks, positional information, causal masking, and image-to-text cross-attention.
category_rationale.pedagogy: The objectives and explanations follow a clear progression from local connectivity through attention mechanics to positional, causal, and multimodal uses while maintaining precise terminology.
category_rationale.practice: Six progressive, page-anchored exercises test tensor shapes, token information flow, Q/K/V attention shapes, equivariance versus invariance, causal masking, and cross-attention source roles with explicit evidence and evaluation criteria.
category_rationale.consistency_usability: Symbols, tensor conventions, terminology, source boundaries, limitations, and page anchors are internally consistent and reviewable.
